default.description: The floating surfaces fit their content and close themselves: the panel and the HUD resize to what they drew, and every surface hides itself — the panel after a switch, the HUD on its dwell, the sheets on Esc. hide and set-size are the window permissions beyond the default set; measured live, without allow-hide the panel stayed up after every switch and the HUD's dwell never hid it — the person read that as «висит вечно». The window verbs need their permissions too: the dots are real buttons (close, minimize, toggle-maximize) and the titlebar drags the window (start-dragging) — the core:window default set carries none of them, so dead verbs were measured live as «никак не закрыть и не подвинуть».
